parsed.note_claim: The heat signature on the NASA map is from routine gas flaring at the Mumbai High offshore oil field, not a US destroyer hit by Iran.

parsed.quote: The Mumbai High Field , formerly called the Bombay High Field , [ 1 ] is an offshore oilfield 160 km (99 mi) off the west coast of Mumbai
